svg.aria-label: What Fit and media.c add: Fits the window: The picture scales to the window, which reopens at its last size.; Pause, then Resume: Resuming after a Pause redraws the whole screen.; ISO at launch: BMC_ISO mounts an image as the server's virtual CD.; One-press Caps Lock: On macOS, Caps Lock takes a single press.; Native media library: media.c, built at install, runs on Apple silicon, ARM Linux, FreeBSD.; Secrets stay out: The log never holds the password, the session cookie or the tokens.
